description: What Have It Printed does and what it costs: the products, prices, accepted file types and sizes, and how each is mailed. Call it when you need prices or limits; it needs no job and changes nothing. Returns a short summary and the same facts as structured fields. Needs a Bearer API key, like every tools/call (POST /v1/onboard to get one).
name: hip_get_service_info
title: Service info
